title: TerminalTransport.attach replays all prior output before streaming new bytes
context: PTY output begins the instant it spawns, before React has mounted anything. On Windows the opening line blocks until an emulator answers.
decision: Every call to onData begins with everything the shell has already said, then continues with new bytes. An emulator mounting late still sees the whole session.
consequences: Terminal always fills from first keystroke, never starts blank. Every terminal is permanently initialized rather than having to wait for live bytes.
